Our March update is here!

Unfortunately we were not able to get the needed translations for the new witch, potions, or NPC hobbies so we're pushing those updates until next month. We did get some of April's quality of life updates in though!

notes.title: Fall Update
notes.content:
Happy Fall 🍁
We’re happy to roll out an update that’s focused on some quality of life updates to enhance your time while playing Echoes of the Plum Grove! 

Check out what's new:

Update Highlights:

   
  Inventory Management Made Easier: A new dropdown feature has been added to help you sort inventory and chests with ease.
     Tailor Shop Refresh: The tailor's inventory will now shuffle cosmetics you’ve already purchased.
     Gifting Medicine & More: You can now gift medicine, potions, or soap to help prevent or heal diseases in NPCS or family members. These items follow the gifting cooldown, so plan wisely!
     Smarter Family Movement: Family members will now spend less time blocking the stairs or lingering in the entryway.
     Pet Cap Increased: You can now have up to 5 pets! More critters for your family to love and care for.
     Improved Shop & Storage Control: Updates for smoother interactions while navigating shops and storage.
     Tidying Up Achievements: We’ve removed unreleased content from the achievements list and collection book to ensure everything matches the current in-game content.


Thank you all for your continued support and feedback! We're constantly looking for ways to improve the game, so keep sharing your thoughts with us.

notes.title: Family Trees & Mac Compatibility
notes.content:
Family Trees

We’ve added a new feature to help you track the family histories of your character and of each villager. In the Family tab, you'll now find a tree icon in the upper right corner. Clicking on it will take you to your family tree. There you can explore the connections and relationships. Additionally, you can click on individuals in the Village tab to view their family trees. See when people died, cause of death, year they were born, spouses, children and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/6f9da3667d4c20a8b36625de3dc143480bf99a6b.png

Mac Compatibility

We are also excited to announce that Echoes of the Plum Grove is now compatible with Mac! We’ve been working hard to get an experience for our Mac users, and we can’t wait for you to join us in exploring Honeywood with us.

Thank you for your continued support. We look forward to seeing all your family trees! 


Sarah and Erik

notes.title: New Pets, Villagers, and Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
Thank you all for your patience as we roll out more content and bug fixes!

We are Steam Deck Verified!
We are thrilled to announce that our game is now officially Steam Deck verified! You can enjoy a seamless and optimized experience on your Steam Deck to take Plum Grove on the go. Thank you to all who helped us test and for your patience while we perfected the Steam Deck experience!

New Content

  Cockatiel, Lovebird, and Parrot addition (all can perch on your characters shoulder!)
  Dachshund, Shiba Inu, Samoyed, Tortie Cat, and Siamese cat are all new pet options.
  Tourists, immigrants, and ghosts may be custom characters from our Kickstarter backers
  New items: garden bed
  Added a stone vein to the mine


Now, when tourists visit, a new villager arrives, or you encounter a [spoiler]blood moon[/spoiler], the villagers you see might be custom-made characters from our Kickstarter backers! Don't be surprised if you see interesting outfits or unique names walking around or moving into town.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/ef3e918572e52aaf5d8d46d179ac46e7da912667.png

Bug Fixes 

  Fixed infinite loading and cutscene issues when switching characters
  Fixed issue with multiple tools that could do the same task - fixes using your pickaxe in the mine among other issues
  Fixed tiles that are unusable on your farm on reload
  Fixed the issue where if an item is dragged for too long it becomes huge
  Fixed green thumb perk
  Fixed issue where moving your barn doesn't clear the animal trough
  Various dialog fixes
  Various controller fixes
  Master and ambient volumes settings should be loaded correctly at startup
  If you change your heir to a farm helper the day you take over as them, you will not constantly transfer your items to the farmer helper chest


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/1d3938bdc59fd29ceb3b84c2c3f2f33cd7d3495c.png

Quality of Life Changes

  Reduced wheat, oat, and corn prices. Increased flour price
  Performance fix: Increased performance when many villagers were on screen
  Performance fix: Reduced performance issues of farm helpers without any tasks
  Simplified Chinese: Update item hover to have visible tags
  New graphics option to reduce or turn off snow effects
  Keyboard pops up for text input on Steamdeck
  Scaled up smaller fonts and UI elements on Steamdeck
  Updated tutorial tab text based on current control scheme
  Cooking multiple items will also multiply skill gain appropriately
  Added checkmarks in collections menu when you've cooked a recipe or caught a fish to help track achievements
  Eggs can now drop at increased quality



We are having exciting updates in progress and we can't wait to share them with you soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/83a59d19ccec1f17effcfc240d020213d0a9230b.png

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 is live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/dd8a0cbfbb4edaaec89a17d8bf8de5cbe0d9fdc4.png
Can you believe it's been 2 weeks since we've launched? So many of you have shown your support for our cozy lil' game and we can't thank you enough.

It took us a bit, but we wanted to make sure we had everything as polished as we could make it for this update. We did our best to tackle as many bugs as possible and rebalanced a few things based on community feedback. Along with some adorable new features like the additional pet skins, this update also includes full controller support and basic modding capabilities!

Along with those key features and all of the updates listed in the patch notes below, we've also started to compile a list of frequently asked questions. You can check out the current list on the Plum Grove FAQ in the Steam Discussion board.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/d3ea497728e5ac95fd6e6a0f29976a96b18f4f52.png
We know of a few issues that remain with controller support which we are continuing to work on. We will be monitoring both our Discord and the Steam Discussions closely to make sure everything is working smoothly outside of these remaining issues.
 Interact button on your farm
 Shop/Chest menu
 Pressing A when talking should complete the current text first
 Item drop hovers
 Inability to input text

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/8d3cd8748bdc342a894be26c8f337ea7e5e7a05e.png
The world of community-led modding for Plum Grove has officially begun! Basic mod support has been added to the game and the community has already started creating. Make sure to backup your saves and use the mod support at your own risk when it comes to save files and progression. Join our discord to find more information on mods.
 Unzip https://unwoundgames.com/mods/cosmetics.zip to your game's data path: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Unwound Games\Echoes of the Plum Grove\mods
 Type in "mods" into the redeem code box

notes.title: Post-Launch Plans
notes.content:
We cannot thank you all enough for the overwhelming support since launch!

With over 400 reviews on Steam already and a bunch of wonderful people sharing their feedback and passing along bug reports for us to look into, this has truly been an amazing few days. We wanted to make sure to take some time to address a couple of the bigger concerns and share our plans for the coming weeks with all of you.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/c5dff5ebceacdfa66028e41b7ececbb589de7034.png

First things first, we’ll be dropping an update next week sometime! This update will include more pet options, bug fixes, and improved controller support! Even if we don’t quite reach full controller support in the next week, we will continue to improve it with the goal of full controller support as soon as possible.

We couldn't help but give you a little teaser of one of the birds, even though they're not flying into the next update. But here's some good news: you'll get two new cat options, one new dog option, and even a pet pig to pick from! That means you'll have four pets to choose from—excluding our feathered friends. Secondly, we are aware of a game crash happening for a small set of Windows 11 users. We have been working with our publishers to try and replicate the issue but have had no luck so far. If you happen to have a game crash (or any other bug/issue), we would greatly appreciate you joining our Discord so that we can work directly with you to try and get as much information as possible. If you can’t join Discord or simply don’t wish to, sharing as much information as possible with us in the Bug Reports forum on Steam is another option.

Outside of the upcoming patch, we also wanted to share some of the other upcoming features on the horizon.

 Steam Deck Verification
 Furniture/Decor for walls such as paintings and hanging pots and pans
 Family tree menu so that you can see your lineage
 Ability to inoculate your family / give medicine to family members
 Saving the Sick Quests (NPCs who will request medicine be sent through the mail)

Lastly, one of the things we have picked up on from our community is the lack of help with large farms in terms of watering. We are having talks about how to fix this, but as a quick fix, we are going to be putting in a unique potion you can buy from the witch (for relatively cheap) that once drunk, rain will be triggered the next day ❤️ 🌧️  We hope this helps in the short term for all our fabulous players out there. 

Given that we’re a small team of two, we’ll be working hard to deliver as many of these features within the first month. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work through this list. Please know that we’ll be around throughout May to fix bugs, implement the new content, and answer your questions. 

Kickstarter Stretch Goals
We also want to remind you of the stretch goals from our Kickstarter campaign!  You can look forward to these making their way into the game in the future: 

 Thunderstorms
 Three songbirds for your home interior
 New character: Old Man Rickett!!
 NPC painting Hobby: You’ll be able to purchase unique paintings from NPC’s with this hobby! 

Again, thank you so much for your support!  We are intently reading feedback, our bug threads, and watching people's playthroughs and we are shocked by how much you guys are loving the game ❤️
We are looking forward to the months to come and seeing all of you dive in and enjoy Echoes of the Plum Grove. If you haven’t yet, we’d greatly appreciate it if you left us an honest review on Steam. Steam reviews are incredibly important for indie games and more reviews mean more wonderful gamers like yourselves can discover the game.

Happy Legacy Building!
Sarah & Erik

notes.title: Echoes of the Plum Grove is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Echoes of the Plum Grove is OUT NOW!


First off, we want to thank so many of you who have supported us through this journey! This game has been our baby for the last 6 years, and getting to share it with you is something we've dreamt about for so long! 

Our team made Echoes of the Plum Grove because we are die-hard farm/life sim fans with a love for unique hand-drawn art styles. We wanted to create our own world that continues to evolve and change to share with you all and it's finally here!! 

You can purchase Echoes of the Plum Grove here, or the deluxe version with the soundtrack here, both are 10% off with a limited-time discount.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536090/Echoes_of_the_Plum_Grove/


💞 How Else You Can Support Us
Being a really small indie team of 2 people, there are so many ways you can help support us and the game.


 If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and we'd love to see your thoughts and experiences through a review.
 Sharing the game through word of mouth with family and friends or on social media with your followers can really help spread the word and give others a chance to discover their next adventure. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.
 Join the amazing community in our Discord and follow us on Twitter to share in the excitement with other cozy gamers!


With your support and feedback, we will continue to do our best to make Plum Grove even better!  We still have a lot of ideas for new and exciting content to add in the next coming weeks as free additional updates that include...

  more pet options
  modding capabilities
  Family Tree
  Pet birds
  QOL Improvements, and more!



From the bottom of our hearts thank you for making this possible! We can’t wait to hear from you. 


Happy Legacy Building!
Sarah & Erik

notes.title: Emotes, Walking, and Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
With only 18 days to go until release, we couldn't help but add a few new features for you all! We're beyond nervous for the upcoming few weeks, but we're also SO excited to see you all play our game for the first time!

Walking Cycles and Emotes
Now, with every step you take, you can show off your characters personality even more with 5 different walk cycles to choose from. Whether you’re strolling through your farm, wandering into town, or exploring the wilderness, your character can be proud, scared, sad, nauseous, or walk like an older villager. Using either right trigger or right click, a menu will pop up where you can choose which emotes to equip.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/6d7d714f12f7f2008fa3473d44b60e99be3197f1.png

We've added 9 actions emotes, which will only play when you stand still,  and 9 expressive emotes to convey a range of emotions and activities. Your chosen emotes will also work with any walk cycle you pick or action you pick!

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/12a2ee103a89fcd93bfca955ec2fbaa1e3c81ee2.gif
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/e78c1421d894742fd2b8e78be920c87781bddfae.png
Steam Achievements
But that's not all! We're also introducing 45 Steam Achievements for launch. From mastering the art of farming to uncovering the secrets of the island, these achievements should reward your curiosity and skill! Whether you're a completionist or you just enjoy passively achieving goals, there's something here for everyone. And for those who love a good mystery, 13 of these achievements are hidden, so you'll need to really explore and talk to villagers to 100% everything! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/ef2b5f471e3c14badce1e29f31dc94e0b5e2c30d.png

See you on the 29th of April!

notes.title: Season's Greetings from Honeywood & Kickstarter Update
notes.content:
As the snow blankets Honeywood, and villagers decorate their homes with festive wreaths, it's time to welcome the awaited Winter Gala! The island is abuzz with excitement, and all the villagers are excited to to bring this festive celebration to life!
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/e78c1421d894742fd2b8e78be920c87781bddfae.png

Throughout the day of the Winter Gala, the Cranberry Collection Contest begins, scattered across the island are 40 cranberries, waiting to be discovered. Depending on how many you collect, rewards range from a modest sum of money to significant social boosts with the villagers. It's a delightful way to explore the island, and who knows what secrets you might uncover along the way!

As evening falls, the Town Hall becomes the center of festivities. Don't miss the punch bowl at the event - it's not just a drink station, but also an indicator of your success in the Cranberry Collection Contest. The more cranberries you gather, the more full the punch bowl is!
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/4ad5bcfa4f585a4416cbde125ca9136269d1d721.gif

We're incredibly excited for you to experience these winter festivities in Echoes of the Plum Grove. Remember, the Gala is just a glimpse of the myriad of events and surprises that await you in Honeywood.

Speaking of a myriad of events, our Kickstarter was fully funded!
We ended with 757 backers, and a total of  $29,909 pledged. So many exciting stretch goals were reached and we can't wait to begin implementing them before our 1.0 launch!

notes.title: Dev Diary #01
notes.content:
Hi there everyone!


We have been working hard at creating the best game possible for you guys and neither my partner nor I are very good at posting. So, apologies for taking so long to get our first official post out but it feels so great to finally start keeping everyone updated on our progress! It has also become a lot easier to start posting with the help of our amazing publisher, Freedom Games. Partnering with them has taken a lot of extra work off our backs so we can focus on getting as much content as possible in the game before we launch next year!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/ed28751f1c4d65f86f6d07c77850a0ab7e543bfa.png

We have a lot in now than we did just 3 months ago. A couple of really cool updates: all NPCs have some form of a hobby ranging from bug catching to dancing! We really want to not only give a lot for the player to do, but for the NPCs as well. NPCs are a big part of the player experience, so having them make human choices was very important for us to implement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/95a0292bcd236de841a1d8802dd5281649f7bef7.gif

Apart from NPC upgrades, we now have all the dyes for clothing in the game! Go crazy with picking outfits and dyeing them 10 different colors. We also have a vast range of hairstyles, facial hair, glasses, hats, and shoes. I am always frustrated as a player when I don’t see enough customization in games to perfectly describe the character I’m playing, so we made sure to give as much as possible. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/aa8011c425cc73b287e03731b44e5619ac4694ae.png

We are very excited to start keeping everyone updated on our development and we will start posting more regularly as we get closer to our launch time. Don’t forget to also wishlist Echoes of the Plum Grove while you’re here on steam!
